name: pi-shared-typecheck
comment: The typecheck script runs `node .../typescript/bin/tsc`, not the .bin/tsc shim. This directory is shared between the host and the dev container through the bind mount, and podman machine's virtiofs presents whatever the container's npm wrote as mode 0600 — readable, but not executable. Going through node needs read permission only, so either side can run a type-check the other installed.
description: Dependency scope for every package's `npm run typecheck`. The compiler and pi's type declarations live here rather than in any package's own node_modules for three reasons. First, the packages deliberately have no install step at all — Node 24 strips TypeScript natively, so `npm test` and the extensions both run straight from source — and a per-package node_modules would exist only to serve this one command. Second, it is 260 MB: shared/test/container/lib.sh stages a package by copying it, and that copy has to stay cheap. Third, it is identical for every pi extension, so one install serves the whole repo. shared/tsconfig.base.json's `paths` point the compiler here; nothing at runtime resolves through this directory.
versionNote: The four @earendil-works/* pins are the pi release the extensions are written against, and must stay in step with PI_VERSION in shared/versions.env, which is what CI installs globally for the interactive tier. A lockfile cannot interpolate, so the literals live here and the pairing is held by this note.
